description: This file declares APIs for handling RBUS table operations such as get, set, sub, add, and remove row handlers, specifically related to the WTC (possibly Wireless Telephony Controller) components.

methods.name: WTC_TableUlongGetHandler
methods.description: Handles getting a ULONG value from a WTC table via RBUS.

methods.name: WTC_TableUlongSetHandler
methods.description: Handles setting a ULONG value in a WTC table via RBUS.

methods.name: WTC_TableUlongEventSubHandler
methods.description: Handles event subscription for a ULONG WTC table.

methods.name: WTC_TableStringGetHandler
methods.description: Handles retrieving a string value from a WTC table.

methods.name: WTC_TableStringSetHandler
methods.description: Handles setting a string value in a WTC table.

methods.name: WTC_TableStringEventSubHandler
methods.description: Handles event subscription for a string WTC table.

methods.name: WTC_TableAddRowHandler
methods.description: Adds a row to a WTC table.

methods.name: WTC_TableRemoveRowHandler
methods.description: Removes a row from a WTC table.
